extensions.answer: Yes. Each dispatch stores the exact confirmer payload, the canonical A1-A12 allow-list that produced it, the excluded-path list, and attestation = sha256(canonical_rules_json || SEP || payload_bytes). A third party recomputes that hash from the stored payload and rules without consulting an agent. Independently, a substring diff of the payload against the union of excluded artifact bodies is empty. With exclusion disabled the same tree's payload contains the implementer receipt, so the detector is not silent in both states.
